header.title: Student Data Import
header.description: Upload student screenshots to extract student names and some stats with OCR.
header.recommendation: Screenshots from the student detail (basic info) screen are recommended.
header.freeOcrNote: This feature uses only free OCR and the extracted results can be edited.

splitNotes.leftTopBottom: Images are split into left and right sections for OCR.
splitNotes.leftColumns: The left side is additionally segmented to extract names and stats.
splitNotes.paddleOnly: Only the current default OCR setting is used now.

errors.studentsNotLoaded: Student data is still loading. Please wait a moment and try again.

errors.invalidSchaleInput: Could not read the SchaleDB string. Please check that it is valid JSON or Base64.
errors.noImageFiles: No image files were found. Please choose images or a folder that contains images.
errors.imageAnalysisFailed: Failed to analyze the image. Please try a different image.
